scope.selection: Global technical baseline for every Chinese localization surface.
scope.rerasterize: The release snapshot owns all selected visible glyphs.

cjk_fixed_canvas.reason: Render every CJK glyph from the global HarmonyOS Sans SC Regular source at one 22px em and one shared baseline in the fixed 24x24 cell. Character-specific trimming, resizing, point sizes and corrections are forbidden.
